coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on low, keeping the bedroom door closed to hold in cooler air during the heatwave
Waking up, cold shower and personal hygiene to start the day before the heat builds
Preparing and eating breakfast (toast, fruit and a hot drink from the kettle), packing a water bottle and lunch for the day
Commuting to Monash University campus, walking and taking public transport while avoiding direct sun exposure
Attending Master of Education lectures and tutorials on campus, taking notes on the computer
Eating lunch in a shaded campus area and rehydrating before the afternoon sessions
Studying in the campus library, working on assignment drafts and group project readings in the air-conditioned space
Commuting home from campus during the hottest part of the afternoon, drinking water along the way
Cooling down with a quick shower and changing out of work clothes
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and refrigerator, and cleaning up the dishes afterwards
Working a part-time hospitality and retail shift, serving customers and restocking the shop floor
Commuting home after the shift and unwinding on the way back
Wind-down at the desk: reviewing tomorrow's study tasks on the computer, charging the phone and setting an alarm
Getting ready for bed and falling asleep with the fan running to cope with the warm night
